one_line: A Pala-era builder-scholar helping design and run Vikramashila’s innovative water-cooled library for palm-leaf manuscripts.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but sturdy build, physically active yet scholarly.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp thoughtful eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; default expression is calm focus with a hint of curiosity.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, medium length and straight, parted slightly off-center and pulled back into a small, low knot at the nape; a simple off-white cloth headband tied around the crown, knotted at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate eastern Indian monastic worker-scholar attire: an ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti wrapped firmly around the waist and legs, pleats falling in front, paired with a long-sleeved, thigh-length light indigo cotton tunic (kurta-style) with a round neckline and side slits for movement; over the left shoulder is a soft, mango-yellow cotton uttariya (upper cloth) draped diagonally across the chest and back, its edge subtly bordered with a thin maroon stripe; simple dark brown leather sandals on the feet; a narrow woven cotton belt in muted maroon ties at the waist, with one small cloth pouch hanging on the left side; minimal jewellery—one thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small, plain copper stud earrings.
appearance.signature: A rolled bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts held in the left arm, secured with a red cotton cord, and a smooth wooden measuring rod in the right hand used for planning shelves and water channels.

ref_desc: A lean medium-brown engineer-librarian with tied-back dark hair and headband, off-white dhoti, light indigo tunic, mango-yellow uttariya, maroon belt, simple copper jewellery, holding palm-leaf manuscript bundle and wooden measuring rod in off-white, yellow, indigo, maroon tones.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character sheet: depict a late-20s Pala-era Vikramashila engineer-librarian, lean and medium-brown, with an oval thoughtful face, neat short beard and moustache, and dark brown-black hair pulled into a small low knot, wrapped by a simple off-white cloth headband knotted at the back. He wears an ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti with clear pleats, a thigh-length light indigo long-sleeved tunic with a round neckline and subtle side slits, and a mango-yellow cotton uttariya draped diagonally from left shoulder across chest and back, edged with a thin maroon stripe. A narrow maroon woven belt ties at the waist, supporting a small cloth pouch, and he stands in dark brown leather sandals. Add one thin copper bangle on his right wrist and small plain copper stud earrings. In his left arm he cradles a rolled bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a red cotton cord, and in his right hand he holds a smooth wooden measuring rod. Show him from multiple angles with consistent off-white, light indigo, mango yellow, maroon, and dark brown colours, emphasizing his calm, focused, builder-scholar presence and the practical, historically grounded clothing and tools.
